description: CTRI large-sample sign/rank stability census (design 8.4, 13.4, 22.3): 100000 frozen continuation families, Fraction-exact. The large sample tightens the rate estimates of continuation_scale_v1 without changing the rates; reproducible locally in about one minute. A server-scale run (N >= 10^7) via scripts/run_on_autodl2.sh can tighten further.
